analysis.overall: You maintained 80% time in range today despite a late-night rise to 222 mg/dL and persistent morning lows. Stacking multiple small correction boluses overnight eventually brought the high down, but likely caused the prolonged dip after sunrise.

events.title: Afternoon meal rise
events.description: Lunch and a small correction led to a mild peak of 194 mg/dL, which settled smoothly back into range within two hours.

events.title: Late meal & midnight spike
events.description: An evening meal of 40g carbs triggered a steady rise that peaked at 222 mg/dL shortly after midnight.

events.title: Early morning low
events.description: After a series of overnight correction doses, glucose hovered around 67-69 mg/dL for over an hour.

events.title: Extended morning dip
events.description: Glucose dropped to a daily low of 61 mg/dL and remained stuck in the low 60s for nearly an hour before recovering.

events.title: Lunch recovery
events.description: After hovering near 70 mg/dL around noon, lunch boluses brought glucose comfortably back up into the mid-130s.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch out for stacking multiple small correction boluses during late-night highs, as the combined tail can lead to persistent morning lows.
